items.prompt: What does it mean to disassemble an object?
items.answer: To take it apart into its pieces

steps: Disassemble means to take something apart.

items.prompt: Can a tower of blocks be taken apart and made into a car?

steps: The same blocks can be rebuilt into a new object.

items.prompt: When you rebuild blocks into a new object, do the blocks change?

steps: The pieces stay the same; only the arrangement changes.

items.prompt: Why can the same blocks build many different things?
items.answer: The pieces can be put together in different ways

steps: Different arrangements of the same pieces make different objects.

items.prompt: Can snap-together bricks be taken apart?

steps: Snap-together bricks come apart to be rebuilt.

items.prompt: What stays the same when you rebuild blocks: the pieces or the shape of the object?

steps: The pieces stay the same; the shape changes.

items.prompt: A student builds a bridge, then a house, from the same blocks. What changed?
items.answer: The way the blocks were put together

steps: Only the arrangement changed, not the blocks.

items.prompt: Is an object made of pieces easy to take apart and rebuild?

steps: Objects made of separate pieces can be disassembled and rebuilt.

items.prompt: Name an object made of a set of pieces you could rebuild.
items.answer: A block tower (or a brick toy)

steps: Block towers and brick toys are made of pieces.

items.prompt: True or false: the same set of blocks can make more than one object.

steps: The same pieces can build many different objects.

items.prompt: Explain how a tower and a car can both be made from the same blocks.
items.answer: You take the tower apart and use the same blocks to build the car

steps: The pieces are reused in a new arrangement.

items.prompt: Describe an account showing a set of pieces becoming a new object.
items.answer: Build a tower, take it apart, and build a car with the same pieces

steps: Using the same pieces for both is the evidence.

items.prompt: Why does taking blocks apart not destroy the blocks?
items.answer: The blocks are separate pieces that stay whole when taken apart

steps: Disassembling separates the pieces without changing them.

items.prompt: A student wants a car but has a block tower. What can they do?
items.answer: Take the tower apart and build a car from the blocks

steps: The same blocks can be rebuilt into a car.

items.prompt: What is the evidence that a set of pieces can make different objects?
items.answer: The same pieces built both a first object and a different second object

steps: Reusing the same pieces for two objects is the evidence.
